text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ............ I... can't find the words.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
What should I say? How can I get through 
to them?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The cheers, the tension, the headwind... 
All of it was completely new to me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—So much so that I found myself wishing... 
"Please, don't let this end."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...That's just how overjoyed I was!
choice_data_list:
You were really moved by that, weren't 
you?

You were really moved by that, weren't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yeah. My heart is still pounding...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I want to run more. I want to enter more 
and more races!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Waah~! Trainer, let's move forward to the 
next one! Hoist the sails♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Whoa!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes, I will sit. Before that?
choice_data_list: Let's get a bit more used to running.

text_block_list.text:
"Due to special circumstances, Fine 
Motion's training is behind schedule 
compared to the other girls."

From here on, raw talent alone won't be 
enough. I explained our plan: build up 
fundamentals, enter races based on her 
condition, and gradually get her 
accustomed to racing.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh, true enough...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Understood! I'll build up plenty of 
stamina and get used to it so my heart 
doesn't race too much!
choice_data_list:
Think about which races you'd like to 
target as well.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh? I'll leave that up to you, but...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's training or anything else, 
I'm just happy as long as I can run♪
choice_data_list:
It's easier to improve when you have clear 
direction.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I see, I see...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Got it, I'll think about it! While running 
a whole bunch!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm so happy...♪ I wonder if I can 
run the equivalent of a lap around the 
Earth in three years!

And so, it was decided that growth through 
the Junior year would focus mainly on 
training.
